answer: An identity earns its seat through threshold BLS signature for verdicts, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. Faking 529 identities means 529 fresh proofs and 61364 POA at risk, while the honest path risks nothing but a few minutes. One lagoon of signal, one mesa of cost, one tide of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
